title: Leo's Space Adventure to the Doctor
label: Blood test

friend.name: Zip
friend.look: a cute Space rockets with big friendly eyes and a shiny metal body

plan.label: Needles or shots
helps: sit up on the grown-up's lap in a comfort hug instead of lying down
look at a video, bubbles, or a toy during the poke
know it hurts for about 2 seconds, then it is over
ask: numbing cream about an hour before
a cold or vibrating device on the arm (like Buzzy)
doing it sitting up, in a comfort hold
counting down "3, 2, 1" only if the child likes that

plan.label: Being away from me
helps: the grown-up stays in the room
know when the grown-up will be back, with a picture
ask: staying with the child the whole time
being there when anesthesia starts and when the child wakes up

pages.text: I go to the doctor. I see a big building.
pages.say: Hmm... hello, Leo! It's me, Zip! [excited] Today... the doctor! You and me. Here we go!
pages.scene: A smiling child and Zip, a cute Space rockets with big friendly eyes, walking towards a big clinic building.

pages.say: Ooooh! Look, Leo! The wait room. The big wait room! Can you see it?
pages.scene: The child and Zip sitting in a wait room with toys and chairs.

pages.text: It is OK to feel worried. My grown-up is there to help me.
pages.say: Hmm... feeling worried? That is OK, Leo. Your grown-up is here. And me too!
pages.scene: The child sits close to their grown-up, who gives a gentle hug. The friend snuggles in too. Calm, soft light.

pages.text: My name is called. I stand up.
pages.say: Ahhh! What is that? Your name! Let's go, Leo.
pages.scene: A nurse calling the child's name, with the child and Zip standing up.

pages.text: I pick an arm. It is my choice.
pages.say: Oh my! Look! Two arms. Which one, Leo? You choose.
pages.scene: The child and Zip in a room with a nurse, choosing which arm to use.

pages.text: A band goes tight. It feels like a hug.
pages.say: Psst... look over here! A band. It goes tight. Like a rocket seatbelt!
pages.scene: A nurse putting a stretchy band around the child's arm, with Zip beside them.

pages.text: I see a needle. It is small.
pages.say: Hmm... what do I see? A needle. It is small. Just for a second, Leo.
pages.scene: The child and Zip looking at a needle, with a nurse holding it.

pages.text: It hurts for 2 seconds. Then it is done.
pages.say: Psst... Leo. Now the poke. A sharp poke. It hurts for 2 seconds. One... two... done! I'm right here. Squeeze your grown-up's hand.
pages.scene: The child sitting on their grown-up's lap, with Zip beside them, and a nurse giving the shot.

pages.text: I get a bandage. It is colorful.
pages.say: Ooooh! Look, Leo! A bandage. The colorful bandage! All done!
pages.scene: A nurse putting a bandage on the child's arm, with Zip and the child smiling.

pages.text: I have my blue blanket. It makes me feel safe.
pages.say: Ahhh! What is that? Your blue blanket! You're safe, Leo.
pages.scene: The child holding their blue blanket, with Zip beside them and a grown-up hugging them.

pages.text: The visit is over. I get to play.
pages.say: Hmm... what's next, Leo? Playtime! You and me. Space rockets!
pages.scene: The child and Zip playing with space rockets toys, with a grown-up smiling.
